$comment: Advisories that have been READ and judged not to apply to this app.
Not a mute button: audit-gate.mjs fails on anything not listed here, and
ALSO fails once an entry is past `review_by`. An exception that never
expires is how a security gate turns into decoration.
Adding an entry means: you opened the advisory, you can say why this
codebase is not exposed, and you named a date to look again. If you
cannot write the `reason` without hedging, upgrade instead.

allow.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
allow.reason: The ReDoS needs an attacker to supply a crafted extglob PATTERN. In the production tree picomatch is reached only through tailwindcss (via micromatch, anymatch, readdirp, fast-glob, chokidar, tinyglobby, sucrase), which matches the static `content` globs written in tailwind.config.js ("./index.html", "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}") at BUILD time and watches files in dev. No pattern comes from a user or a request: the browser bundle does not contain picomatch and the backend is Python. It is in the production tree only because tailwindcss-animate (a build-time plugin under dependencies) declares tailwindcss as a peer, the same path as the braces entry closed on 2026-11-16. There is no forward fix: the advisory range is <=4.0.7 and 4.0.7 is the latest picomatch published (checked 2026-11-17).
